decks.notes: This Grixis Control deck focuses on disrupting opponent's strategies while controlling the board through counterspells and removal spells. It includes powerful cards like Ancestral Recall, Time Walk, and Time Vault to gain advantage, alongside strong planeswalkers like Narset, Parter of Veils and Dack Fayden. The deck also features key artifact synergy with cards like Manifold Key and Tinker to combo off with powerful win conditions like Sphinx of the Steel Wind and Bolas's Citadel. The deck aims to outvalue opponents and control the game until it can secure a win.

This deck aims to win the game by using the combo Doomsday, which involves stacking your deck with the perfect set of cards to create an unbeatable board state. It starts by using card draw spells like Ponder, Preordain, and Brainstorm to manipulate the top of the deck. Dark Ritual and other mana acceleration cards help generate mana quickly. Once Doomsday is cast, the player rearranges their deck to set up a win condition, typically using Thassa's Oracle to win the game instantly. The deck also includes disruption and protection spells like Force of Will and Duress to counter opponent's plays.

This Vintage 1 vs 1 Aggro - Fish deck focuses on quickly developing a board presence with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Questing Druid, while disrupting opponents with cards like Force of Will and Spell Pierce. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Oko, Thief of Crowns and Narset, Parter of Veils for additional control and card advantage. Using fast mana accelerants like Black Lotus and Moxen, along with card draw spells like Treasure Cruise and Ancestral Recall, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents early in the game and maintain pressure throughout.

The deck revolves around utilizing cards like Paradoxical Outcome, Tinker, and Yawgmoth's Will to generate card advantage, mana advantage, and combo off quickly with powerful artifacts like Time Vault and Bolas's Citadel. It aims to quickly assemble key pieces and disrupt opponent's strategies with cards like Force of Will and Flusterstorm, while also utilizing cards like Hurkyl's Recall and Karn, the Great Creator to control the board and ensure victory through its powerful combo potential.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifact mana sources and card draw spells to generate a large amount of mana and draw through the deck quickly. The goal is to assemble a combo involving cards like Paradoxical Outcome, Tendrils of Agony, and Bolas's Citadel to win the game in a single turn. The deck also includes disruption like Force of Will and Flusterstorm to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Ancestral Recall, Time Walk, and Yawgmoth's Will provide additional card advantage and combo potential.

This deck focuses on using artifacts and control elements to manipulate the game, generate card advantage, and handle threats effectively. It utilizes powerful mana acceleration cards like Moxen and Sol Ring, along with key artifact combos such as Goblin Engineer and Time Vault to gain an advantage over opponents. The deck also includes a range of counterspells and disruptive elements to control the pace of the game, making it difficult for opponents to enact their strategies effectively. Ultimately, the goal is to outmaneuver opponents and secure victory through superior resource management and strategic plays.

This deck focuses on utilizing artifacts, land destruction, and taxing effects to disrupt the opponent's game plan while ramping into powerful threats like Golos, Karn, and Mystic Forge. The combination of Mishra's Workshop and Sphere of Resistance allows for explosive starts, while Crucible of Worlds and Wasteland disrupt the opponent's mana base. Urza's Saga can tutor for key artifacts like Chalice of the Void, Thorn of Amethyst, or Pithing Needle to further disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with pressure and disruption while controlling the game with its powerful artifacts.

The deck focuses on efficient control and disruption, utilizing various counterspells and removal spells to maintain board control. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage through card draw effects and recursion. The inclusion of Mishra's Bauble and Urza's Saga allows for additional card selection and potential value generation. The deck also features a strong mana base with disruptive lands like Wasteland and Strip Mine. Overall, the key concept of the deck is to out-value and out-control the opponent through a combination of disruption and card advantage.
